subject: PSR
body: Under the Public Service Rules, compulsory retirement is at
options: 65 years of age or 40 years of service
55 years of age or 30 years of service
60 years of age or 35 years of service, whichever comes first
explanation: This is set out in the Public Service Rules; some groups such as teachers have different statutory ages.

subject: PSR
body: How long is the probation period for a newly appointed officer on a permanent appointment?
explanation: The officer is confirmed if service is satisfactory.

subject: PSR
body: Under the 2021 Public Service Rules, maternity leave is
explanation: This was extended to 16 weeks in the 2021 edition.

subject: PSR
body: Paternity leave for a male officer whose wife delivers a baby is
explanation: Introduced in the 2021 Public Service Rules.

subject: PSR
body: Annual leave for officers on Grade Level 07 and above is
explanation: Officers on GL 06 and below get 21 working days.

subject: PSR
body: Annual leave for officers on Grade Level 06 and below is
explanation: Officers on GL 07 and above get 30 working days.

subject: PSR
body: Which body has power to appoint, promote and discipline federal civil servants?
explanation: Its powers come from the 1999 Constitution.

subject: PSR
body: Who is the head of the Federal Civil Service?
options: Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
Secretary to the Government of the Federation
explanation: The HoCSF oversees career management of civil servants.

subject: PSR
body: Which body receives asset declarations from public officers?
explanation: Public officers declare assets on assumption and on leaving office.

subject: PSR
body: Which tribunal tries breaches of the Code of Conduct for Public Officers?
explanation: Established under the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution.

subject: PSR
body: Which body regulates public procurement in Nigeria?
explanation: Set up under the Public Procurement Act 2007.

subject: PSR
body: Who audits the accounts of the Federation?
explanation: The Auditor-General reports to the National Assembly.

subject: PSR
body: Who is responsible for preparing the consolidated accounts of the Federation?
explanation: The Office of the Accountant-General manages Treasury operations.

subject: PSR
body: In a federal ministry, who is the Accounting Officer?
options: The Director of Finance and Accounts
explanation: The Accounting Officer is responsible for the ministry's funds.

subject: PSR
body: Into which fund are all federal revenues paid, except where the Constitution says otherwise?
explanation: Section 80 of the 1999 Constitution.

subject: PSR
body: What is the Treasury Single Account (TSA)?
options: A unified set of government bank accounts that consolidates government cash
An account at a commercial bank for each ministry
A savings account for civil servants
explanation: It is held at the Central Bank of Nigeria.

subject: PSR
body: IPPIS is used by the Federal Government to
options: manage personnel records and pay salaries
explanation: Integrated Personnel and Payroll Information System.

subject: PSR
body: The Public Procurement Act was enacted in
explanation: It set up the Bureau of Public Procurement.

subject: PSR
body: The Freedom of Information Act was passed in
explanation: It gives the public a right to access public records.

subject: PSR
body: The Fiscal Responsibility Act, which promotes prudent management of public finances, was enacted in
explanation: It also set up the Fiscal Responsibility Commission.

subject: PSR
body: Under the 1999 Constitution, how many states make up the Federation?
explanation: Plus the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja.

subject: PSR
body: Which part of the 1999 Constitution contains the Code of Conduct for Public Officers?
explanation: It covers conflict of interest and asset declaration.

subject: PSR
body: Under the 1999 Constitution, a public officer must NOT
options: put themselves in a position where personal interest conflicts with duty
explanation: Conflict of interest is prohibited by the Code of Conduct.

subject: PSR
body: A memo is mainly used for
explanation: Letters are used for external communication.

subject: PSR
body: 'Minutes' of a meeting are
options: a written record of decisions and discussions
the agenda sent before the meeting
explanation: Minutes are confirmed at the next meeting.

subject: PSR
body: An agenda is
options: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting
explanation: It is circulated before the meeting.

subject: PSR
body: A query issued to an officer is meant to
options: give the officer a chance to explain alleged misconduct
explanation: Fair hearing is a principle of discipline.

subject: PSR
body: Which principle requires that an officer be heard before being punished?
explanation: No one should be condemned unheard.

subject: PSR
body: The federal character principle aims to
options: promote only the most senior officers
reflect the country's diversity in public appointments
explanation: Section 14(3) of the 1999 Constitution.
